posts.title: i'm not artistic, genetically speaking
posts.description: I see myself as a creative person. However, my genetic pattern is associated with a lower likelihood of making art, I found out this week for the price of a £45 DNA testing kit. I have a weak visual imagination, or perhaps have a brain whose reward system prefers life's other pleasures. posts.title: the glimmer
posts.description: I've taken a shine to a shine that's enthralling, like I'm a dolphin and the glimmer's another, who's calling. The glimmer is one part light, starting in heavens, impossibly making its way down to earth, and one part distance. The distance from, not the distance to. Distance too far, not distance gone wrong. A perpetually over there kind of thing.

posts.title: a ticket to see the sea
posts.description: If natural wonders weren't so abundant, so that they be could be gated and privatised, people would pay millions for the sunset experience I just had for free. I'm amazed that in a busy city, I can sit on the beach, and be one of four people witnessing a one of life's great spectacles.
